_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Contractor Evaluation of Technical Publications and Recommended Changes
summary: Specifies requirements for a contractor evaluation report on the technical adequacy of existing technical publications supporting system or equipment operation and maintenance, including recommended changes.
use_relationship:
To obtain information from contractors relative to the adequacy and accuracy of existing technical publications which are intended for use in support of the operation and maintenance of system/equipment(s).

a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

b. Provides an evaluation of the technical adequacy of existing technical publications and, as required, recommendations for changes which are considered necessary in order for the subject document(s) to comply with interfacing documentation requirements established by the procurement document.

c. Not authorized for use with Air Force Technical Orders (TOs).
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: Data shall be in the contractor's format.

children.title: Provide an evaluation report for all commercial technical publications
children.content: regardless of source or type (i.e. technical manual, handbook, data sheet, etc.) intended for incorporation into the equipment/system technical support material package.

children.title: Include but do not necessarily limit the report to the following information
The contractor's evaluation of the adequacy of text and supporting illustrations
A description of the equipment, its capabilities, and theory of operation.
Procedures necessary to operate the equipment/system in all modes of operation.
Instructions for preventive and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, test alignment, and calibration procedures.
Parts information sufficient to identify and order (from commercial or Government supply sources) failed parts.
Software or firmware descriptions, where required, either through coverage or references to documents that contain pertinent information.
Other information to support the evaluation.
The report for each revised document shall provide the following information
The contract number and date of the report.
Identity of the reviewing activity and the as of date of the review.
Complete equipment nomenclature including part, model, and/or serial number.
Title of the document, publication reorder number, and date of issue.
Price and availability of the date and the quantity required.
